sevenzip-wasm 26.5.0, compiled from 7-Zip 26.05 (Alone2)

Copyright 1999–2026 Igor Pavlov and other contributors. The generated
JavaScript/WebAssembly is LGPL-2.1-or-later with the unRAR restriction; see
LICENSE. The restriction prohibits using the RAR code to re-create the RAR
compression algorithm. Michiflin does not offer creation of RAR archives.

The corresponding upstream sources and build scripts are included alongside
this notice. To rebuild, unpack source-wrapper-26.5.0.tar.gz and unpack
source-7zip-26.05.tar.gz into its 7zip subdirectory (the upstream git
submodule), then follow build.sh and README.md in the wrapper source.
Emscripten and its toolchain are needed separately. The two packaged library
files are separate assets and may be replaced with a compatible rebuilt copy.

Upstream wrapper tag 26.5.0, commit 7b53d4abf78d:
https://github.com/arktronic/sevenzip-wasm/tree/26.5.0
Upstream 7-Zip 26.05, commit b88c6bc09339:
https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/tree/26.05
